convention: Connection matrices have derivative-of-basis rows, so coefficient columns use d+N^T. The line h=(N12,-N02,0) is the unique actual holomorphic Higgs kernel. Its invariant-line test is h wedge (db h+N^T h).
independent_method: Native rational first/second derivatives and canonical matrix derivatives differentiated directly by SymPy, then recursively evaluated; no native Taylor-series jet routines imported.
specialization: G_a and normalization 2u+c are units, all evaluated connection denominators are units, and canonical fibers are smooth. Nonzero wedges therefore prove characteristic-zero rational nonidentity on this normalization component.
scope: Excludes a flat holomorphic line in each mu3 character along generic b, and consequently a constant CM E0 summand of this restricted Prym VHS. Does not exclude H20 of the total support, variable factors, correspondences, or other source routes.
